author: Subkriptikal
title: Take it from me. It’s a well built game.
content:

You’ll see what mean, but either way THIS IS POLISHED on a level that most devs just don’t care enough to do. It’s obvious that y’all care about making a good game as much as making money. Props.

author: Hiitsme!!!
title: Hours of Cerebral Entertainment
content: Many of the comments on here are correct. I thought it was gonna be more like enemies in your path, mow them down. There is a small part like that but once you progress, the reward is laughable. I have been playing for years & still notice more playable content. You can change your lieutenants, upgrade their armor, change weapons & items( rings, scrolls, cloaks, etc), enchant items, & bedazzle them as well. No one’s army will be exactly the same. Subtle differences with different jewels & enchantments. Definitely a town building game as well, you can upgrade all buildings which help you gain certain items for the city. Like I said extremely entertaining with so many different outcomes. A very good game, also from the comments, you can spend money for bonus items, gold, building materials, tar, warriors, monsters, & so much more. I love it!!

author: POTL017
title: Chest rewards
content:
This game is very fun, and I enjoy playing daily. The events , tournaments, and all that are very enjoyable and well done. The ability to translate and understand everyone is also very nice. The community is mostly very welcoming and nice to one another. Of course there are outliers, but that is to be assumed. Not everyone wants to play for everyone to succeed. It is a war game after all. 

My only disappointment is chest rewards. At a certain point in the game food, and speed boosts being the main thing that comes out of the rewards is annoying. Speed boosts, during the ancient vaults, and runic raids. It’s a little much to be getting so many of those. Food, coming out of rewards chests so often becomes useless after a certain level. Our clan buildings are over stocked with food, and the army only uses so much food. Most people have billions of food just stuck in the items because it’s not being used. It would be nice to have the odds of food coming out of clan chests to be dropped, and more of the resources to be raised. 
I understand that this is a business, but it might encourage more people to support that business if they get the things that actually help them grow. Most people don’t have the money to be spending weekly to achieve growth in the game. But, some players may be more likely to buy a few things here and there if they received the proper resources to grow without spending. I feel like this also would prevent people from quitting the game at a certain point where growth slows down.

author: MC Magic Matt
title: Fun, Pay To Win, and Intense
content:
I’ve played the game for a little over a year now. It’s a lot of fun for sure. But what makes it fun is the people in the game and, once you figure it out, the math behind the battles. I willingly admit I have spent a LOT of money on this game, but for the amount of fun I’ve had, it’s been with it. 

That being said, I just started a new city (a new game if you will) and I see a lot of changes in the UI.  Devs, PLEASE, do not bury things in nested menus forcing users to have to click and click and click.  A click and a scroll is much easier on us.  The filters on the telescope are nice for crypting/monsters but it’s a lot faster to simply see the whole list and find the one you’re looking for.

And also, please PLEASE give us a way to extract clan player data and battle data from the game. Despite what how much I’ve enjoyed the game I’m really close to quitting because of the work and difficulty to manage a clan. I just want to play the game and make sure my clan members are active and we have ZERO TOOLS to do that with. The graphics are fine. Stop mucking with them.  Stop taking the menus and nesting features.  Give us tools to manage clans, and especially give us SOMETHING to better moderate chat rooms. Having one admin is not enough. Let us assign like, one moderator PLEASE.  I’ve got a list of things that I think would really help the user experience, to simplify how we interact with the game and each other and allow for better clan management. Because this is all about the people.  That’s what makes the game fun!

author: WiredLizard
title: In game organized bullying and payments
content:
Worst game experience and environment ever. 
Very unorganized seems to be predator based game where the higher organized ranking players control how the game is actually played. “The kings court” will hold you “accountable” for attacking another player and you are bullied to pay for “damages” or resources lost in the game during battle. None of the following is disclosed in the ToS or in how to play the game. 
Apparently each “world” has different “RoE” “Rules of engagement” which now changes how the game is designed to be played and what is expected of you and how much you need to pay them to stay playing. The “players” will ask to be paid in game resources. If you do not pay they make it hard to play this game as players with higher ranks will bully you to play and pay them. Players set up multiple accounts to keep up the amount of numbers to dominate other players. Some offer for you to buy resources from them from their websites posted in the game chat.  Even for other player’s actions that maybe on your team. You are harassed and bullied until you pay in game resources. If you do not pay the other players will make it so difficult to play you will want to quit. 
You don’t know or can you Identify who is the games admin or is it just another player in the game telling you to pay. You will also be harassed from other players asking for WhatsApp information in the game and clan chats. Worst experience in any game I’ve played.

author: T R Johnson
title: I like the game but
content: The game glitches a lot and I’m wondering if there will ever be more levels in the mini games where you can purchase the legendary pass otherwise that feature of the game is a waste. The game is very costly some of the in game purchases should be cheaper because you can’t really build your clan strong and fast without spending money and can’t really achieve anything without buying seasonal passes. I recommend some slight changes to developers for players that do spend money like for example if you pay for the golden pass for the triumphal challenge it should automatically include the heroic pass benefits for the trials of Olympus. Vice Versa for the bundle pass for the triumphal challenge including the mythic rewards for the trials of Olympus. A happy customer will continue to play the game if they know they’re getting a bang for their buck and not paying for everything. Other than what’s listed about as far as game play. I hate that members with way higher levels take advantage of players with way lower levels. I also dislike that some of the challenges only seem to benefit higher level players, the smaller level players don’t get to get much rewards because we can’t compete with the higher levels for top spots if they put people on somewhat equal levels in the competitions with top prizes for that level it works be more fair for all players. The game is fun to kill time with but it needs a lot of updates to make it even better.

author: Rob Pountain
title: Very expensive to play competitively
content: First off the game is fun but it is very expensive to play competitively. It would take you three months to do what somebody can do in one week for $250 pack. They even have a $500 pack support for the game is there, but they are slow. I had a problem and they kept overwhelming me with emails that wanted me to explain the same problem over and over again until eventually I just got sick of it in gave up so in the end my problem was never fixed. All I know the game is a lot of fun. Everything works fine, they do maintenance just like any game but unfortunately I don’t have the cash flow to level up as fast as others. I spent $2000 in the first month and my friend spent $7000 the first month so when I go in the farm for the valor points, that’s what levels you up I get like 200,000 compared to his 2 billion so he levels everything up very quickly whereas me I’m looking at a couple months plus but this money is no object for you. Enjoy the game it’s fun on the other hand if you don’t have a money tree in your backyard, be prepared to take an extreme amount of time to level up, they will put you in a new kingdom with other new players in the you have five or six months to level before they open the kingdom to all 130 some kingdoms most of those players already billion might you’ll be lucky to be at 5 million 10 million and that’s if you spend money $2000 got me right around the 7 million might

author: 6002bert
title: Not really like the ads, but I ended up liking it
content: I joined because of the ad where you collect more guys and move in a line shooting the bad guys. You know the one. There were a very few levels of that sort of gameplay besides 6 short rounds per day that aren’t really like the ads as much, most of the game is just collecting materials to build up your kingdom, sending your 3 captains out to explore crypts for materials or fight monsters for points, and interacting with other players. You can join a clan— which I have and I really enjoy the people I play with—and you can be attacked and demolished by people who pour literally hundreds of real life money into leveling up. I have definitely put a few bucks into this game as it’s pretty difficult to move up and recover from big attacks without it. If you’re wanting the game because of an ad, don’t. If you’re wanting a game that will take up time and give you small serotonin hits when you level up or get to click buttons to complete daily tasks, get it. If you don’t have real life money to put into it… well, it IS possible to grow, you just have to be careful about how you save/spend the daily gold. I will say I’m most disappointed in the lack of further levels to participate in game play like the ads. The end.

author: played 4 4 yrs
title: Game has gone downhill fast
content:
Used to be fun game. Allowed for different strategies to fit the player. After a couple of years, game has changed where free to play players have no real chance. All the good parts sucked out to force players to purchase packages. No new clan based upgrades to the games in over 2 years.  Every time they try and add a new way to spend on the game, they mess some other parts up requiring multiple patches. In 5 yrs, it’s obvious they don’t utilize a sandbox server to test out changes. They have been blocking a lot of accounts claiming there is violation of rules. After 5+ days, get your account back. They admit it’s a screw up. They do NOT compensate for the packages you purchased (mercenaries, time limited things for 2 day events, etc). You bought something and it’s just gone. Complain about it to your credit card company and they will permanently ban your account. Our clan has had 7 people banned in the past week. 2 got a email saying “you can log back in. We made a mistake” followed by 5 more people. All top members of our clan when there is once a quarter event on going. Find a different game. Developers and support no longer care about the players. Game has been bought/sold several times in past few years.

After the reply from the developers, they should look at the many players in BBX that they have blocked and then days later unlocked their accounts…WITHOUT compensation! Lost their packages they paid for (time limited to use). Players get accused of asking for a refund when they haven’t. It’s a problem on the developers end.

author: ScamTechBS
title: Great game but….
content:
After a bit it becomes a battle of wallets than strategy. The game likes to drain the valuable assets you need to succeed, like gold and tar, limited might rewards and mercs, so you have incentive to buy it with cash. 
It’s fun to play and it’s very easy to get into relationships with your clan, if you’re in a decent one, but be careful of the wallet warriors. Some-many are very aggressive about the money they blow, and aggressive about defending their right to do so while either subtly or outright trolling those who can’t. It becomes a battle of narcissistic dominance than player strategy, but that’s life in 2023, isn’t it? Lol. (Good luck humanity.) If players with money see others get ahead based on intelligence or strategy, look out, the passive aggressive attacks in chat will happen, or aggressive attacks in the game in general.  Also be careful of the ones who climb Might quickly, they pay to get there, run their mouths in chat, bully others, and then don’t know how to play the game. It’s fairly common. 
Then there’s the low intelligence types who say offensive things or go on in the chat about the animation of female body parts. I guess the game developers really prefer, and favor, stupid people or people who spend money. People who actually play the game, play with tactics, and put effort into it will be slowed down, trolled, and eventually pushed away. It’s a game for wallet warriors. 
Money is everything in 2023, everything online is now one big endless harassment machine for money - websites, social media, news, streaming, music, emails, and games. Enjoy this game to the extent of your wallet limitations, then move on in life.

author: Nickpaz
title: Scam of a game.
content:
After playing for a year, have deleted this scam. Customer support is horrible. There are MAJOR bugs in the game that have been ongoing for over a year. They always lie. Servers have never been upgraded to deal with their horrible lag. Furthermore, the developers are shady and even have their own accounts that come in to cause troubles and wars, and attacking your cities, destroying your armies, in hopes that you will spend more money. I have also witnessed clans outright bribing moderators to mute people they don’t like, and customer support taking no action against this, even when given 100’s of screenshots and videos. In short, this game is nothing more than a pay-to-lose scam that is full of bugs. Lastly, it is coded so poorly, it will eat up your battery, and make your cpu run hot, even when nothing is going on. This is true even on the fastest machines.

 Response to developer comment: Everything you posted is a lie. If it were true, there wouldn’t be bugs that are YEARS old, there wouldn’t be people flocking away from the game faster than you can make new accounts to give fake 5 star reviews, and there wouldn’t be total inaction to the abusive mods, and to the accounts you created yourselves to cause problems and make people spend more money. In short, you are the most unethical company since Enron.

author: Double-dipper
title: Go away! Now! You have been warned!
content: This game is not the cute little intro that you see in all of their ads. It’s not the nice little logic game using math against time to increase your stick man army size and defeat a cute little enemy as you cross bridges, avoid obstacles, and do math in your head on the fly. If that’s all it was, it would’ve been good because that’s the only reason I signed up for this game. But that’s like one percent of what the game is actually about. And it’s not cheap. This game is a money pit! It’s extremely confusing, ambiguous, difficult, and blind. There are no Help screens to speak of. The objective of the game is extremely obscure. Advancing in the game is nearly impossible without dumping hundreds and hundreds of dollars into it. Furthermore, other players are constantly attacking you and destroying the things that you have paid for with hard cash. So unless you have $1 million you don’t know what to do with, just stay away from this game. Now I’m sure that the developers are going to attach a paragraph at the end of this saying that the game is free to play. This is a lie. Repeat! THIS IS A LIE!! it is impossible to play this game for free for very long and not find yourself cornered at a point where you are forced to buy their upgrades. Just stay away from this game. You’ll be glad you did.

author: Creative D Square
title: Unauthorized ongoing charges to my Credit Card, customer service never responds to any questions.
content: While the game it’s self is fun, I’ve run into a few things that do not seem ethical. The only reason I noticed charges on my account was because I had been missing items from a Gold Pass so I went back to make sure I did in fact purchase the correct package. I did, but noticed several monthly charges also that I know I did not make because I contacted support to ask about a lot of Gold Pass items I didn’t receive, so I wasn’t planning on buying anything else until that was resolved. Chat customer service never responded so I filed an unauthorized charge with Apple and they took 1-2 days to investigate or do whatever they do and refunded the money. A few minutes later, I’m blocked from the game. No explanation. Again, I contacted customer service and no explanation. I finally figured out searching online that they block a player if they submit a change back on Apple or via your credit card. Since then, I got a response from chat rep and they closed my account “case” saying you’re blocked because you violated our rules, and we are too busy to respond with anything else right now due to high volume; but never answered any of my questions about for how long I would be blocked, or what happens to my items when/if I’m reinstated into the game, or why I had all those charges if I didn’t make them. Doesn’t seem ethical to charge accounts, not respond, block accounts after you try to get your money back for unauthorized purchases, and close inquiries about the issue because they are too busy. I had invested so much time and money into this game and I guess it’s time to find a new game that’s not made by this same company. Very disappointed.

author: thizblowz
title: Awesome game!
content: I really enjoy playing Total Battle. I’m not one for social media but I love my clan and clan mates so it makes logging on each day a lot of fun. As far as the other comments about it being costly, that’s really up to you. There are ways to get the things you need but you have to play every day and complete your daily tasks to get them. I recommend you join an active clan. I get close to 300 chests per day being in my clan. This gives me most of what I need to grow, and we get more during certain events. Again you can’t get them if you don’t play. I do spend money on the golden pass. It’s $20 per season which is about a month long. You double your rewards with this pass. If you like strategy games and are looking to meet some great people in the total battle community from all over the world then this game is for you. My only suggestion would be implementing some kind of a warning when your shield of peace is close to expiration. This would give you time to prepare a new shield or at least make sure you have time to use up resources.

author: Rbrown 400
title: Money thieves and no support
content:
I started this game months ago. Very addictive and fun at first. You need to make purchases in order to get ahead and get with a strong clan in order to make it. Which after months I did manage to do just that. Very supportive nice players from all over the world kinda cool actually. But like a switch if developers cant fraudulently take advantage of you your account will be blocked and support will ignore you. (I’m not the first one) read the reviews. 
So what happened to me is I made a expensive purchase in the game. The charge went through and I received the items almost immediately. The next day I received an email receipt from Apple and there were multiple identical charges. When I checked the game it only showed one purchase so I thought the problem was with Apple. I requested a refund and Apple quickly refunded the extra charges. The next morning went to play the game and got a notice that I was “blocked” due to a violation and to contact support, so I did. Asked what was going on and the response was that I withdrew payment for items already received and my account was suspended. I replied back with all the proof and an explanation just to be ignored. I then contacted the developer directly (email) very descriptive explanation with screen shot proof of what happened just to be ignored as well. So months of game play and money later, I can no longer access the “free” game anymore. I’m not upset about the money. I even later offered to pay to get my game back just to be ignored. I lost friendships and a really good town that took over 6 months to build simply for not wanting to be taken advantage of. 
My advice don’t even think about downloading this game. Huge disappointment.

author: Anonymous Criticizer
title: Game is missing core functions, such as operating without your wallet.
content: You can’t do anything without opening up your wallet in this game. Do you want to progress and get more valor points? Well, the easiest way to do that and get multi millions is to throw your army at the brick wall. That is epic monsters. All of your army will perish. But you can just revive them right? Correct, but it requires paid currency. You might be able to get like good action daily from your clan if it’s an active clan, because of crypts. Oh, and in seven days, the army will be deleted. Nothing in this game is instantaneous, in fact, it’s the opposite. You’ll be waiting 30 days to upgrade your capitol or you’ll be waiting an hour just to train some guardsmen. It’s all speed up with this, it’s all artificial delay that, even for building. There are multiple high stakes classes that are just locked behind arbitrary buildings, that you have to get five other buildings to some arbitrary level just to upgrade it. it’s not pay to play, it’s pay for basic features addictive that will have attempted to spend even more hundreds for nothing. If you’re judging it from my standpoint of separating users from your money, I’m sure it’s doing its purpose. But if you are judging it from the point of an actual standalone game without spending any money, it’s at 0/05 stars. Horrible, locks basic features such as renewing army behind paid currency that is collected at such a low rate, even through clans. This game has potential if they stopped such purposeful, money extracting design, I like the soundtrack, the visuals are nice. The game play loop is not. Do not expect to get anywhere without opening your wallet. And even then you have to be frugal and find the best expected value.

author: Cap'n chaoss
title: Bait and switch money grab
content:
Beware! This game tricks you with the scrolling shooter one in the Ads and then slowly switches you to the real game which is 100% designed to take your money, your time, and will eventually take over your life if you try to keep up with its demands. I found myself putting off work and avoiding social situations to play and I spent over $2,000 before I saw the light. 

Highly addictive. They trick you into thinking you’re becoming more powerful, leveling up your troops, until you realize they just increase the demands each time you do so. Essentially, the gameplay is always the same no matter what level you achieve and it becomes a monotonous burden. It’s hard to walk away because you’ve invested so much time already and made so much ‘progress’. But the investment has no redeeming value and the progress is all in your head. 

Developer support is a cruel joke. They take weeks to respond and when they finally do they give you one chance to make your case and then will shut the chat down. There is no dialogue like with normal tech support. If you want to retort you have to open another case! Avoid this game and go out and enjoy real life!

author: JJRocz
title: Game is a ripoff.
content: Money money money Everything about this game revolves around you spending money. They advertise it as a free to play game. Yet in order to participate in the game or even to protect yourself from getting utterly wasted, you need to spend money. “Premium” is $5 usd per week. 260/yr. and you get to swap gear and translate messages, tho the translation is inaccurate. In order to be “competitive” in the game, you have to spend 250/wk on special mercenaries, and that’s after 6months of spending that kind of money to grow an army size that can be competitive. 12,000/year. To play the game. Yet you get 0 return from customer support on the developers fixing issues within the game. You have to use an outside chat service bc the one they advertise as having doesn’t work. They perform maintenance in the middle of major events, they don’t answer your questions to support for 3-5 days. And again, only way to be competitive and grow to be competitive is spending in the neighborhood of 250/wk if you spend 50 for a package, they will offer the same package for 100 for a week to 10 days. It’s the same thing, yet double the price. It almost feels criminal the way this company operates.

author: Christlife
title: Believe the bad Reviews
content:
First if you want to get ahead in this game you won’t be able to unless you PAY. Pay crazy amounts of money for things that don’t help you much. And even if you paid thousands of dollars for this game you still wouldn’t catch to players who have been playing for months. It would be a good game if certain levels were only allow to attack same level players but it’s not its players who have spent a lot of money attacking players who haven’t spent any money. Theres a reason only 12k people have downloaded this vs 3 million who have downloaded something like the clash of clans app. If this game used brackets and levels allowing them to only attack players who have the same levels then it would be decent at best. And to level up anything whether your city, weapons, captains will literally take you months and you will still get no where unless you spend money. 

Save your time and money and download a game where everyone has a real chance to grow and upgrade because this is NOT the game. And if you see “support” responding to these reviews DO NOT believe what they say trust me it’s all lies, it’s just run around talk!!

author: T0ucH30
title: 5 hours into it…
content: I’m a real weird case here, I downloaded to see if it actually had those math levels as advertised, But that’s just a small part of it, The meat of the game is your city and building, strengthening, Forging, Crafting and so forth…I don’t like strategy games, I’ve honestly never been into them but this one sucked me in like others haven’t. It’s true that it’s not a cheap game at all and not beginner friendly but I catch on fast since I’ve been playing video games since 1990 lol, But in all honesty it’s a great game underneath the layers of paywalls. I’ve supported the devs with $10 but I’ve seen ads where only people do really well in this terrible economy would find to be decent prices, they’re steep. Really really steep. I bought 2 items because why not I support devs these games cost money, just think of the players as well because if it’s too much I rather play a console game, but I’m sticking with this as long as the greed doesn’t overtake the experience! Great game though

author: Leatrix641
title: New update makes game a waste of $$$
content:
I’ve been playing this game for over a year. In that time I have had a wonderful experience with clan members and gameplay. I have been happy to spend money and even interact with seasonal kingdom, which is an extremely intense time and money commitment. With the last update to the game within the past few days, what has happened is that developers have now made it harder for players to not only grow but sustain themselves in order to get the resources that they need. It is reminiscent to some of the other battle strategy games like Dawn of Titans, where devs want all the money that you can give them and you absolutely have to spend a minimum of $80/month in order to ensure that you get the rewards that you need to keep your account growing. I am seeing players drop off and say that they are going to stop playing this game and they cannot fully support a game that is trading money for fun. There’s a balance and they have just tipped the skills in their favor completely. 
For reference, I am a G8 player with two accounts that I am active in to high achieving clans.

author: cooking maryArr
title: Growth is the same for everyone
content: The game makes you upgrade everything equally. Therefore all players upgrade their cities the same. There is no secret advantage that you could choose. Your capital level and hero level gives away how strong you are. So someone with better troops always knows your weaknesses. We should be able to pick different paths of strengths to fool attackers. Like for instance, we should have a secret protection of stronger health or a secret talent where we get a double strikes. How about being able to build up our warehouse as strong as we want, without having to upgrade all the other buildings, so we don’t lose so much when attacked. Maybe it could be a hidden boost that protects our warehouse 100 percent. Any advantage where a strong attacker at least pays some price for attacking a weaker city. How about a secret boost we could buy with gold, where we acquire all the conquest points after a player burns our city? Right now, we just keep getting targeted, and losing a bunch of progress.

author: Called&Sent4Him
title: Honestly love it
content:
Was skeptical at first as I had never really played games like this before.

Started as something to kill time when bored at work. Stayed because of the camaraderie amongst clans and kingdoms. 

There are whole governing bodies of players who maintain order in the game in their respective kingdoms and they help protect and educate new players. Which I find fascinating because there is nothing that prompts you to do so in the game. The Rules of Engagement, the clan diplomats, judges, high councils, none of this is built into the game. It is all user created and it is it's own unique community right here in the palm of your hand.

I will say, that to really get ahead in this game at a reasonable pace, it is most helpful to at the very least get the twenty dollar golden pass every other month. It lasts until the end of the 30 day season so it's best to get it at the beginning. It allows you to unlock a lot of helpful resources you will need to grow and stay productive.

All in all, I have to give this game 5 stars. It is a great escape from the stress of day-to-day life that you can easily pick up and put down at your leisure. 

Though, it is very easy to lose an hour or two unintentionally while playing this game. Especially in the first month or so while you are growing rapidly. 

I highly recommend giving it a try.

author: texburgher
title: Read these reviews, and believe them
content:
Is Total Battle fun and addictive? Sure, just like gambling. 

Is Total Battle buggy? Oh yeah, it’s very buggy. And some of the bugs seem suspiciously engineered to deplete resources you paid real money for. (And good luck getting any relief from Support, who more closely resemble non-player characters capable only of gaslighting and ignoring players.) 

Can you play Total Battle for free? Technically, yes. And technically, you can Michelin Star restaurant for free - as long as you don’t order anything off the menu. You have to pay to make Total Battle any fun whatsoever, and not just a little bit. It’s expensive. 

To have fun playing Total Battle, the entry cost is $40/month - bare minimum. *Most* players I know spend upwards of $200/month, and I’ve known many who have spent into the thousands. 

Can you skirt the expense and grow / have fun without spending money by joining a productive clan? No! That’s the most ridiculous claim imaginable: those clans? The ones who’ll help you grow if you join them? They’re full of paying members, and they are not accepting free-loaders! Sorry! The clans who will have free players are computer-generated or weak, neither of which will help you grow or have fun in this game, so don’t buy that line of nonsense. 

Total Battle is a tiny casino masquerading as a game, the crucial difference being that when you go to a casino, you might leave with some winnings. With Total Battle, however, you can only lose.

author: Allexass
title: I deleted the game without accepting the agreements.
content:
Before clicking “Accept,” I actually read the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service. Most users probably won’t, and I think they should know what they are agreeing to.

According to the company’s own Privacy Policy, they may collect information such as your IP address, device identifiers, advertising ID, approximate location, gameplay activity, session duration, purchases, interactions, and in-game chat data. They also describe creating profiles based on users’ behavior and interests for advertising purposes.

What bothered me most is that they explicitly state they may work with advertising and analytics partners for targeted advertising, including advertising across third-party services. They also state that hashed email addresses may be used with Facebook Custom Audiences and Google Audiences, including lookalike/similar audience advertising.

To be clear, their policy says they do not “sell” personal information to independent third parties. But that does not make this level of tracking, profiling, and advertising data-sharing acceptable to me.

This is a mobile game. I should not have to agree to an extensive advertising and behavioral profiling ecosystem just to play it.

I refused the agreements and deleted the app.

I strongly recommend that other users read these documents instead of automatically pressing “Accept.” Personally, I think practices like this need much stronger legal regulation, because meaningful consent does not exist when companies put extensive tracking terms behind a button most people have to press just to use a product.

author: MC Magic Matt
title: Fun, Pay To Win, and Intense
content:
I’ve played the game for a little over a year now. It’s a lot of fun for sure. But what makes it fun is the people in the game and, once you figure it out, the math behind the battles. I willingly admit I have spent a LOT of money on this game, but for the amount of fun I’ve had, it’s been with it. 

That being said, I just started a new city (a new game if you will) and I see a lot of changes in the UI.  Devs, PLEASE, do not bury things in nested menus forcing users to have to click and click and click.  A click and a scroll is much easier on us.  The filters on the telescope are nice for crypting/monsters but it’s a lot faster to simply see the whole list and find the one you’re looking for.

And also, please PLEASE give us a way to extract clan player data and battle data from the game. Despite what how much I’ve enjoyed the game I’m really close to quitting because of the work and difficulty to manage a clan. I just want to play the game and make sure my clan members are active and we have ZERO TOOLS to do that with. The graphics are fine. Stop mucking with them.  Stop taking the menus and nesting features.  Give us tools to manage clans, and especially give us SOMETHING to better moderate chat rooms. Having one admin is not enough. Let us assign like, one moderator PLEASE.  I’ve got a list of things that I think would really help the user experience, to simplify how we interact with the game and each other and allow for better clan management. Because this is all about the people.  That’s what makes the game fun!

author: Allexass
title: I deleted the game without accepting the agreements.
content:
Before clicking “Accept,” I actually read the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service. Most users probably won’t, and I think they should know what they are agreeing to.

According to the company’s own Privacy Policy, they may collect information such as your IP address, device identifiers, advertising ID, approximate location, gameplay activity, session duration, purchases, interactions, and in-game chat data. They also describe creating profiles based on users’ behavior and interests for advertising purposes.

What bothered me most is that they explicitly state they may work with advertising and analytics partners for targeted advertising, including advertising across third-party services. They also state that hashed email addresses may be used with Facebook Custom Audiences and Google Audiences, including lookalike/similar audience advertising.

To be clear, their policy says they do not “sell” personal information to independent third parties. But that does not make this level of tracking, profiling, and advertising data-sharing acceptable to me.

This is a mobile game. I should not have to agree to an extensive advertising and behavioral profiling ecosystem just to play it.

I refused the agreements and deleted the app.

I strongly recommend that other users read these documents instead of automatically pressing “Accept.” Personally, I think practices like this need much stronger legal regulation, because meaningful consent does not exist when companies put extensive tracking terms behind a button most people have to press just to use a product.

author: @Josepf
title: Fraud and misrepresentation
content:
⭐☆☆☆☆ (1 Star)

I cannot recommend this game.

My biggest concern is billing. On three separate occasions I was charged for in-app purchases that I did not initiate. The most recent incident involved two separate $19.99 charges on July 15. I have in-app purchases disabled on my iPad, and the items associated with those charges were never delivered to any of my game accounts. I have had to dispute these charges with my payment provider multiple times.

Whether these are billing errors or something else, unauthorized charges that require customers to file disputes are completely unacceptable. After this happened for the third time, I deleted the game.

Beyond the billing issues, the game itself is built around constant pressure to spend money. Nearly every event is time-limited, creating fear of missing out and encouraging players to buy “just one more” pack before the opportunity disappears. Progress increasingly becomes tied to microtransactions rather than strategy, and what begins as an enjoyable game gradually turns into an expensive grind.

If you are someone who is susceptible to spending, impulse purchases, or the “sunk cost” mentality, be especially cautious. It’s very easy to invest significant amounts of money chasing temporary advantages that have no lasting value outside the game.

There are many excellent strategy games available that charge a fair upfront price and let you enjoy the experience without constantly pressuring you to open your wallet. Unfortunately, this is not one of them.

author: Sanderson1795
title: Ok game mechanics - confusing UI
content:
I originally installed this game, probably like half the player base, because of the ads showing you shooting monsters and moving left and right to get powerups and avoid debuffs. 

It turns out that’s only about 1/30th of the game. It is a mechanic where you can get rewards, but it’s capped per day. The majority of the game is empire building. That in itself isn’t a bad thing, but the mobile ads definitely mislead you. 

The most disappointing thing is how horribly laid out the mobile UI is. There is a top bar with menus, a sub bar with inventory counts (that scrolls left and right with tiny little arrows), a bottom bar with menus, and random menus spread through the left and right parts of the screen - half of which lead you to purchasing something. The main menu isn’t even easy to find, I had to google it (it’s hidden inside the character screen). 

The most annoying part, and why I quit playing after a week, is that there is a gold currency that is slowly earned and you can use to accelerate the game (that you can also purchase). That’s fine, most mobile games have this. Inside one of the several menus, I was scrolling looking for something and accidentally spent 5k gold (that took an entire week to get since I started) without even a confirmation. No way to undo the transaction. 

That’s why I quit. It’s just not a pleasant user experience.

author: Rob22489
title: Money Grab
content:
This game was fun for a few days but if you want to pay for endless building go download Minecraft, it will be cheaper.

This game feels like endless management of game rules, constant change and communication.  

You have to be a part of a clan to have success building and even then you are constantly searching for new chats with the rules of the kingdom.  Constantly asking questions to the chat which are most often ignored. 

Spend 50-100$ to get a massive army that you send on suicide missions to get points and valor as part of the game and that army will be gone in less than a day.  But you got points and now you are back to waiting for resources or paying.  

Huge time suck, little fun. Requires a lot of $$ to be good and way too much time.

Save your money.  This ain’t the one.

title: Battles are fun but way too much noise, not enough play
content:
The core battle part of the game is super fun and addictive. That said, it’s such a tiny component of the overall gameplay. There is so much mindless clicking to “upgrade” or “research” or “train” parts of the map. The whole game feels like it’s trying to upsell you constantly to speed up all the clutter outside the core gameplay. 

If they took out everything and just left the ability to battle, this game would be amazing but unfortunately you have to wait and mindlessly click a million times in between battles. Or spend loads of money (which I’d never do and feel like most wouldn’t) to bypass all that noise.

I uninstalled after 1 day.
